gloss: photogenic quality; looking good in photos

definitions.gloss: photogenic quality; looking good in photos; instagrammability
definitions.explanation: The quality of looking attractive or impressive in photographs. Often used for food, places, and people that photograph well. Related to the broader trend of インスタ{映|ば}え (looking good on Instagram).

examples.japanese: {写真映|しゃしんば}えするスポットだ。
このカフェは{写真映|しゃしんば}えするメニューが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: This cafe has many photogenic menu items.

examples.japanese: {写真映|しゃしんば}えを{意識|いしき}して{料理|りょうり}の{盛|も}り{付|つ}けにこだわった。
examples.english: I put effort into the food presentation with an eye toward making it look good in photos.

notes:
{写真映|しゃしんば}え describes the quality of looking attractive or impressive in photographs. Used for food, places, scenery, and people.

WORD FORMATION:
{写真|しゃしん} (photo) + {映|ば}え (looking good, shining). The verb {映|は}える means 'to look attractive' or 'to stand out.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {写真映|しゃしんば}えする: to be photogenic, to look good in photos
- {写真映|しゃしんば}えを{意識|いしき}する: to be conscious of how things look in photos
- {写真映|しゃしんば}えするスポット: a photogenic spot

RELATED:
- インスタ{映|ば}え: instagrammable (won Japan's 2017 buzzword award)
- {映|ば}える: to look attractive (standalone verb form)

REGISTER:
Casual and trendy. Commonly used by younger speakers and in social media contexts. {写真映|しゃしんば}え is the more general, platform-neutral term compared to インスタ{映|ば}え.
